title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཉེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 177)
shelf_note: Canonical Pramāṇa commentary volume in the Derge Tengyur collection.

tr_errors_A.english: The eye and the other five senses, along with the mind, constitute the six ayatana
tr_errors_A.problem: Awkward count phrasing ('the eye and the other five senses' plus mind implies seven items instead of six)

tr_errors_A.english: That which is produced immediately after is the basis.
tr_errors_A.problem: Anticipates the predicate from the next lemma ('is the basis') and translates active production as passive

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B provides a cleaner and more accurate technical rendering of Buddhist logic, correctly parsing the sense-bases count and lemma boundaries.

book_verdict: Authentic Derge Tengyur woodblock print folio of Pramāṇa commentary with high-quality OCR and two competent translations, among which B is more precise.
